summary.headline: Pause Config Refresh directly links the 24-hour pause workflow
summary.summary: The pause workflow now uses direct Devices and All devices navigation and directs Intune Administrator and custom-role references to their current destinations. The documented maximum pause remains 1,440 minutes.
summary.adminImpact: Grant Remote tasks/Run Pause Configuration Refresh and managed-device visibility before suspending policy refresh.

summary.headline: Lost Mode sound guidance links directly to the device list
summary.summary: The supervised-device sound procedure now uses direct Devices and All devices navigation and current Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, and custom-role references.
summary.adminImpact: Grant Remote tasks/Play sound to locate lost devices and managed-device visibility before sending the sound.

summary.headline: Quick scan guidance names the current role destinations
summary.summary: The Quick scan procedure now directs operators to Devices and All devices and to current Help Desk Operator, Endpoint Security Manager, and custom-role definitions.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm Remote tasks/Windows defender and managed-device visibility permissions before starting a Quick scan.

summary.headline: Remote Assist guidance uses direct device navigation
summary.summary: The Remote Assist procedure now uses direct Intune navigation for Devices and All devices and current role references.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the support operator holds the documented eligible role and can access the target managed device.

summary.headline: Remote lock guidance names current eligible roles
summary.summary: The Remote lock procedure now points directly to Devices and All devices and to current Help Desk Operator, School Administrator, Endpoint Security Manager, and custom-role definitions.
summary.adminImpact: Verify the operator has the required remote-lock and managed-device access before locking a device.
